C14 and C23 are also closely related series documents, but their operative emphasis is narrower and their language is less directly replicated.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I transmit herewith for the consideration of the Congress the Final Report of the President's Committee to Study the United States Military Assistance Program","parent_excerpt":"I transmit for the consideration of the Congress a report on \"Economic Assistance: Programs and Administration,\" submitted to me ... by the President's Committee to Study the United States Military Assistance Program.","explanation":"Distinctive near-verbatim transmission formula applied to successive reports of the same committee."},{"child_excerpt":"I have submitted copies of this Report to the Executive Agencies concerned","parent_excerpt":"I have transmitted copies of the report to the Executive Agencies concerned","explanation":"Nearly identical administrative step concerning distribution of the committee report."},{"child_excerpt":"shall later communicate with the Congress concerning recommendations requiring legislation","parent_excerpt":"the Committee's recommendations may be carefully considered and, where appropriate, taken into account during the formulation of next year's mutual security program","explanation":"Both letters pair congressional transmission with executive-agency review and contemplated follow-up action, establishing the same functional structure."}]}
